purpose: No root package: a pnpm TypeScript app under apps/, a .NET solution whose test project belongs to it, a second .NET service, and a load-test package under bench/. The app is found with its own pnpm install and its nested lint, type-check, build and test scripts, and the bench package is listed as a satellite, not a component. Both .NET parts are now assessed: global.json pins SDK 10.0.100 under the default patch policy, which the image's 10.0.404 doesn't satisfy, so the audit adds 10.0.100 before the restore. commerce-core builds, but its test project references no test SDK or framework, so there is no test to run; identity-dev uses WebApplication without implicit usings and doesn't build. Both are at Level 0, and commerce-core's 33% share sets the repo level.
